claim_status_semantics: claim_status uses the canonical Claim Schema v1.0 statuses: EXPLICIT | INFERRED | UNKNOWN. EXPLICIT = source-stated semantics; INFERRED = project/AI interpretation or project transfer hypothesis; UNKNOWN = source provides no defining semantics (NOT_PINNED). The 6-class semantic_classification (EXPLICITLY_PINNED / SOURCE_PERMITTED_MULTIPLE_VARIANTS / PARTIALLY_PINNED / NOT_PINNED / REQUIRES_UNAVAILABLE_INPUT / INFERRED_PROJECT_TRANSFER) is a separate research-classification layer.

final_decision.decision_rationale: The source pins the complete trading loop for the Holy Grail pullback: CONTEXT (14-period ADX > 30 and rising; extended-range breakout + new momentum highs from SR-V0-M05), SETUP (pullback/retracement to the 20-period exponential moving average), ENTRY (buy stop above the high of the previous bar when price touches the 20-period EMA), INITIAL_RISK/INVALIDATION (protective sell stop at the newly formed swing low - source-pinned, the key contrast with the NR7 negative result), EXIT (trail stops as profits grow; take at least half off at a price objective; exit on first reaction/pause when giving back too much), NO_TRADE (middle-of-range; ADX<20 declining avoid; do not fade ADX>32 rising; do not guess breakouts), TIMEFRAME (multi-timeframe explicit: base chart then 30/60/120-minute), INSTRUMENT scope (US equities/S&P examples; commodity-futures support UNKNOWN). The remaining gaps (EMA price input NOT_PINNED; swing-low identification; trailing mechanics; qualitative exits) are representable as clearly labeled INFERRED project conventions. None of the NO conditions applies: the initial stop IS pinned, the exit is present (not missing), the trigger is explicit (not discretionary), there is no source formula conflict for the entry parameters (14-period ADX>30 and 20-period EMA are consistent across all accepted materials), and no critical information surface is unavailable (the 30/60/120-minute charts are derivable from owned 1-minute OHLCV; NYSE TICK/breadth is NOT part of the 4-step rules).

semantic_classification_legend.EXPLICITLY_PINNED: the source gives an explicit, unambiguous semantic statement sufficient for faithful representation of the core meaning
semantic_classification_legend.INFERRED_PROJECT_TRANSFER: project/AI transfer or interpretation hypothesis, not an explicit source claim
semantic_classification_legend.NOT_PINNED: the source references the concept but provides no defining semantics
semantic_classification_legend.PARTIALLY_PINNED: the source gives the concept/role but leaves a semantically meaningful boundary, measure, or detail undefined
